messages:
alyssa: heads-up — brought up Solstice LoRA merge for cust-valencia yesterday, ran the smoke pack. seeing increased hallucination on factual QA (dates/locations invented). not big throughput issues but quality regressed on ~6/150 samples.
ben: can you paste a failing example id? quick diff helps.
alyssa: sample 13: asked "When was the treaty signed?" model answered "in 1997 in Lisbon" (ground truth 1979, Geneva).
alyssa: sample 98: generated an extra paragraph with fabricated sources.
ravi: what quant profile did you use? int3 experiment or q4_0?
alyssa: this run used int3-opt (experimental per-channel) to save more mem. command was:
```bash
./eval/run_smoke.sh --model solstice-lora-valencia:int3-opt --batch 2 --max-tokens 200 --seed 42
```
ben: int3 is still dodgy for knowledge retention in some layers. did you also try int4 or int8 baseline?
alyssa: int4 baseline kept factual answers for those samples. int8 is clean. so seems correlation with int3 quant path.
ci-bot: CI-bot: smoke-eval started (job id 1716010050) \u2014 model solstice-lora-valencia:int3-opt \u2014 payload: 150 samples
ben: also, which tokenizer mapping applied? cust-valencia uses a small v3 patch. if EOS/SEP ids moved, that can trigger runaway generation.
alyssa: we merged adapters then applied tokenizer remap (post-merge). map file: /data/merges/valencia/v3-remap.json
jorge: pinging @infra-runtime — could be a kernel rounding issue for int3 causing softmax skew. can you check the activation distributions vs int4?
jorge: also please run a quick A/B: (A) remap-before-merge + int3-opt, (B) remap-after-merge + int3-opt, and (C) int4 baseline. 10-sample quick smoke is fine.
ravi: good call. small A/B will isolate tokenizer vs quant. also capture logits for token positions around EOS for failing samples.
alyssa: starting A/B; jobs: A=1716010110, B=1716010160, C=1716010210. I'll upload artifacts when done.
ben: if A is better, we should update merge-tool to remap before weight fusion for cust-valencia. if none improve, fallback to int4 for the customer and flag int3 as experimental.
ci-bot: CI-bot: job 1716010110 completed. artifacts: https://ci.internal/artefacts/1716010110
alyssa: A results look better — sample 13 fixed, fewer hallucinations. B still shows fabrication. int4 baseline (C) remains best quality.
jorge: then immediate remediation: ship remap-first merges for cust-valencia and set default quant profile to int4 for production. mark int3 as opt-in experimental.
ravi: adding the two failing samples to the "cust-valencia-smoke" promptset and creating an Optimize alert for regression >2% on that set.
alyssa: done: https://internal.eval.redwood/ps/cust-valencia-smoke
ben: thanks — can we get a short note for release notes so support can tell the customer? one-liner: "Applied tokenizer remap before adapter fusion; using int4 as default quant for cust-valencia to preserve factual accuracy."
alyssa: will draft and post to #customer-success after approvals. :rocket:
